paper_title: Paper Copilot A Self-Evolving and Efficient LLM System for Personalized   Academic Assistance
caption: Feature pre-computation significantly improves the efficiency. The time cost for retrieval without feature pre-computation will grow with the exponential increase of paper number, while our proposed feature pre-computation stays unchanged and keeps constant time cost.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the time cost (in seconds) for retrieval as a function of the number of papers, comparing two scenarios: without pre-computation (blue line) and with pre-computation (orange line). The x-axis represents the "Paper Number" on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 256, with tick labels at powers of two (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256). The y-axis represents "Time Cost (s)" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 35 seconds, with tick marks at intervals of 5 seconds. The blue line (w/o Pre-computation) starts at approximately 0.5 seconds at 1 paper and increases sharply, reaching about 35 seconds at 256 papers, indicating an exponential growth in time cost. In contrast, the orange line (w/ Pre-computation) remains nearly flat and constant at approximately 0.5 seconds across all paper numbers, demonstrating that pre-computation maintains a consistent time cost regardless of the number of papers.
